grid.order: year-major, then row-major from south to north, west to east

caption: NASA POWER (MERRA-2) GWETROOT · each year 1981–2025 compared with the 1981–2025 average of the same 2° square. A single year is weather as much as climate: the trend map tests the change. Values are stored in steps of 0.173 percentage points.

processing: read the whole globe for the variable from the temporal (location-chunked) store, in latitude bands covering the full time axis
coarsened to 2 deg cells with edges at multiples of 2 from -90 / -180
yearly means 1981–2025 in each 2° square minus that square's average over the record
no trend test: a playback of the data behind the trend map
provenance.caveat: Data: MERRA-2 reanalysis, a weather model corrected by observations, about 50 km squares (the map averages them into 2° squares). The trend is a straight line through 1981–2025; it shows what changed, not why.
